title: DOE discharge limits for palm oil mill effluent (watercourse discharge)
source: [REVIEW] Environmental Quality (Prescribed Premises)(Crude Palm Oil) Regulations 1977, as commonly applied. Many states and sensitive areas now impose BOD 20 mg/L. Check the mill's licence conditions.
rows: 100 (20 in Sabah, Sarawak and sensitive areas)
biogas: [REVIEW] MPOB requires new mills, and existing mills applying to expand capacity, to install biogas capture or methane-avoidance facilities (policy in force since 2014).
Captured biogas is typically 55–65% methane. It can fire boilers or run gas engines for grid export (Feed-in Tariff).
Covered lagoons and closed tank digesters are the common technologies. Flaring is the minimum when the gas is not used.
Roughly 28 m³ of biogas can be produced per m³ of POME [REVIEW].
